title: grid list view: a row's built-in Edit / Delete greyed by userActions.*.disabledWhen gives no reason (plugin-grid RowActionMenu), unlike data-table since #35293
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZrgaiMgTJCnswR6jQ

Filing gate: ③ an out-of-scope finding of the #35293 dev (os-dev-report 7000362127, PR #35331), read in code at 00cfb78f, not driven live. Follow-up of #35293 / #35135 family, nested under #35135.
Reader: `domain:ui` (`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/components/RowActionMenu.tsx`, published `@object-ui/plugin-grid`). Suggested-grade: p2 · same reach and same ruling as #35135 / #35293 (UX × not every user every time).
Dedupe: `plugin-grid row action disabledWhen reason`, `BuiltinRowActionItem disabled reason`, `ObjectGrid row Edit greyed no reason` — none open.

## 维护者速读

ObjectGrid 列表（例如 app-showcase 的发票，`status == 'paid'` 时编辑变灰）的行菜单「编辑」「删除」变灰但不说原因。#35288 修了记录页，#35331 修了 data-table 行菜单；plugin-grid 的行菜单是同一缺口的第三处。

## Facts (origin/main 00cfb78f)

- Producer: `examples/app-showcase/src/data/objects/invoice.object.ts` declares `userActions.edit.disabledWhen` on `record.status == 'paid'`.
- Path: plugin-grid `ObjectGrid` → `RowActionMenu` → `BuiltinRowActionItem` (`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/components/RowActionMenu.tsx`), which renders `<DropdownMenuItem disabled={disabled}>` with only icon and label: no reason, no title, no accessible description.
- Ruling 6996106574 (route B on #35135): the generic `actions.notAvailableForRecord` sentence, no protocol change, no new key. `useDisabledReason` / `DisabledReasonMenuLabel` / `menuItemReasonAria` already exist in `@object-ui/components` (`renderers/action/disabled-reason`).

## Ask

Apply route B to plugin-grid's built-in row Edit / Delete, matching #35331: when the declared `disabledWhen` holds, show `actions.notAvailableForRecord` as a visible second line and accessible description; accessible name stays the label. ⚠ A `verdictPending` leg (predicate not yet evaluated) must NOT earn the reason. Pins: greyed item shows the reason; CONTROL: no predicate, predicate not holding, and pending verdict show none. Ablate red. `Clause-②: no` expected (check whether the helpers are exported from the published package entry; if a new export is needed, say so).

⛔ Not a claim.
